description: Every 30 minutes, checks the inbox for replies to open enquiry threads raised by Triage new enquiry, draft reply. When a reply confirms the proposed time, raises a booking-confirmation WorkQ item (same decision form) for Confirm new-patient booking to act on. When it doesn't, raises a plain WorkQ item for a human to reply to directly. Threads older than 30 days are treated as stale and stop being matched.

import json

AI_PROMPT = (
    "Read this reply to a new-patient enquiry email and decide whether it confirms the originally "
    "proposed appointment time, asks for a different time, or isn't actually confirming anything yet. "
    "If the reply gives the patient's full name or date of birth, extract them - otherwise leave blank. "
    "Never invent a name, date of birth or time that wasn't given."
)
AI_HINT = json.dumps({
    "confirms_proposed_time": True,
    "requested_alternative": "",
    "patient_first_name": "",
    "patient_last_name": "",
    "patient_dob": "",
})


def write_json(path, data):
    api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


item = params.get("item") or {}
email_id = item.get("email_id") or ""
thread = item.get("thread") or {}
todo_id = item.get("todo_id") or ""
outcome = "skipped"

if email_id and thread:
    try:
        full = api.connectors.invoke(server="m365-mail-read", tool="get_email", args={"id": email_id})
    except Exception:
        full = None
    full = full if isinstance(full, dict) else {}
    body_block = full.get("body") or {}
    body_content = body_block.get("content") if isinstance(body_block, dict) else str(body_block or "")

    proposed = thread.get("proposed_appointment") or None

    try:
        parsed = api.ai.extract(
            prompt=AI_PROMPT,
            input=json.dumps({
                "proposed_time": (proposed or {}).get("starts_at") if proposed else "",
                "reply_body": body_content or "",
            }),
            schema_hint=AI_HINT,
        )
    except Exception:
        parsed = {}
    parsed = parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}

    enquirer_name = thread.get("enquirer_name") or "the enquirer"
    name_parts = enquirer_name.split(" ", 1)
    first_name = str(parsed.get("patient_first_name") or "").strip() or name_parts[0]
    last_name = str(parsed.get("patient_last_name") or "").strip() or (name_parts[1] if len(name_parts) > 1 else "")

    if proposed and parsed.get("confirms_proposed_time"):
        description = (
            "**Enquirer:** " + enquirer_name + " (" + (thread.get("enquirer_email") or "") + ")  \n"
            "**Confirmed time:** " + str(proposed.get("starts_at") or "") + "  \n"
            "**Reason given:** " + (thread.get("reason_for_visit") or "not stated") + "  \n\n"
            "Approving this will create the patient in Cliniko, book the appointment, send the intake "
            "form (if one is configured for this practice) and email a confirmation.\n\n"
            "**Confirmation email:**\n\nHi " + first_name + ", you're all booked in for "
            + str(proposed.get("starts_at") or "") + ". We'll be in touch if anything else is needed "
            "before your visit."
        )
        workq_item = api.workq.create(
            title="Confirm booking: " + enquirer_name,
            scope="org",
            description=description,
            priority="normal",
            assignee_ids=[thread.get("reviewer_id")] if thread.get("reviewer_id") else None,
            labels=["healthcare-practice-management", "new-enquiry", "booking-confirmation"],
        )
        new_todo_id = workq_item["id"]
        api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=new_todo_id, form_id=params["approval_form"])
        write_json("PracticeManager/BookingDrafts/" + new_todo_id + ".json", {
            "slug": thread.get("slug") or "",
            "enquirer_email": thread.get("enquirer_email") or "",
            "first_name": first_name,
            "last_name": last_name,
            "dob": (str(parsed.get("patient_dob")) if parsed.get("patient_dob") else None),
            "appointment_type_id": proposed.get("appointment_type_id") or "",
            "business_id": proposed.get("business_id") or "",
            "practitioner_id": proposed.get("practitioner_id") or "",
            "starts_at": proposed.get("starts_at") or "",
            "intake_form_template_id": thread.get("intake_form_template_id") or "",
        })
        outcome = "booking_approval_raised"
    else:
        alt = str(parsed.get("requested_alternative") or "").strip()
        api.workq.create(
            title="Enquiry reply needs a human: " + enquirer_name,
            scope="org",
            description=(
                "**Enquirer:** " + enquirer_name + " (" + (thread.get("enquirer_email") or "") + ")  \n"
                + ("**Asked for a different time:** " + alt + "  \n" if alt else "")
                + "\n\n**Their reply:**\n\n" + (body_content or "")[:2000]
            ),
            priority="normal",
            assignee_ids=[thread.get("reviewer_id")] if thread.get("reviewer_id") else None,
            labels=["healthcare-practice-management", "new-enquiry", "needs-reply"],
        )
        outcome = "needs_human_reply"
